text: 10 OVERDOSAGE The pharmacologic actions of Calcitonin Salmon Nasal Solutionsuggest that hypocalcemictetany could occur in overdose. Therefore, provisions for parenteral administration of calcium should be available for the treatment of overdose. Single doses of Calcitonin Salmon Nasal Solution up to 1600 International Units, doses up to 800 International Units per day for 3 days and chronic administration of doses up to 600 International Units per day have been studied without serious adverse effects.
